summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the declared signal-only propagation contract: it accepts version, quality, and change inputs, emits queueable re-evaluation jobs, stale markers, and propagation audit records, and does not mutate upstream or downstream authority objects.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable smoke coverage confirms the documented happy path: one source-change trigger linked to a version record and quality record produced two queued ReEvaluationJob records, two StaleObject records, and one PropagationRecord with decision jobs_emitted. Static conformance review also checked sparse, malformed, deduplication, untraceable-path, and unsafe-job scenarios against the implemented validation and branching logic.
test_results.notes: The reviewed code is deterministic, uses stable hash-derived identifiers, preserves input references and dependency paths in outputs, records structured rejections, and keeps motor_020 within enqueue-and-signal responsibilities.
